title: Identity-open comparison and its full-tower normalization data
statement: For a proper morphism f, define finiteIdentity by whiskering the derived identity-open extension isomorphism with ordinary direct image. For each integral coefficient stage define ordinaryReduction as the scalar-extension/restriction adjunct of reconstruction inverse, direct image of the reduction unit, and restriction comparison. Define completedIdentity by deriving the section-normalized identity-open adjoint uniqueness map and the ordinary/completed direct-image identification. For finite-field data use compactIntegral for the fixed identity-compactification integral functor. PreservesProjections is the equality of its actual reduction adjunct followed by finiteIdentity with reduction of theta followed by ordinaryReduction. InducedOnFullTower requires ordinary module isomorphisms whose section maps are canonical identity-base-change restriction and identity on direct-image sections, and theta to be the conjugate of their derived completedIdentity through the fixed compact and strict reconstructions. These are the unchanged constructions used to state the proper coefficient descent argument. Prerequisites: [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], [def-weil-proper-morphism], [def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed], [def-weil-derived-direct-image], [def-weil-compactifications-refinements], [def-weil-compact-support-finite-action], [def-weil-compact-support-coefficient-action], [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi], [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients], [def-weil-integral-scalar-extension], [def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support], [def-weil-extension-by-zero], [lem-sf-strict-direct-image-scalar-comparison].
